_about: The companions a release publishes as packs (docs/packs.md), in the order the apps list them. id is the companion id in manifest.json and on the server; name is shown in the apps and is not translated; notice is a licence text the pack carries, for art whose licence asks for it. A companion is listed only when it has a master for every core pose in poses.json; tools/art-export fails the release otherwise.
